sources.title: Xonovex worktree operation boundaries
sources.provenance: Repository-original preview/apply, separation, and recovery conventions for worktree operations

claims.statement: Create, merge, and cleanup default to preview; abandon is read-only; merge preserves workspace resources; cleanup resolves exact targets and requires separate force or remote-deletion authority.
